status: Available style specification; final outputs require format-specific visual checks
source: Original interpretations of style names demonstrated in a user-supplied video; not recovered source code.
quality_checks: Readable text and measured contrast against rendered colors
No information communicated by color alone
Responsive layout with no horizontal overflow
Content remains readable without blur or animation

motion.reduced_motion: Remove decorative movement and nonessential transitions

name: Comic book
summary: Bold outlines and confident emphasis with a playful editorial voice.
use_when: Use for campaign explainers, memorable tips, and short learning challenges.
avoid_when: Use sparingly in dense reading and preserve stable, high-contrast text surfaces.
typography: Heavy system sans-serif headings with readable body text.
layout: Strong outlined blocks, occasional angular accents, clear reading order.
surfaces: Halftone accents and offset black shadows.

adaptations.web: Use the tokens and live components; validate keyboard, mobile, contrast, and reduced motion.
adaptations.slides: Preserve hierarchy and palette with native editable shapes and text. Replace motion with static emphasis.
adaptations.documents: Use native headings, readable body text, restrained callouts, and solid reading surfaces.
adaptations.images: Describe composition and material cues; check text and layout separately. Do not claim pixel-exact token fidelity.

prompt: Apply Comic book to [DELIVERABLE] for [AUDIENCE]. Purpose: [GOAL]. Preserve all supplied content, existing visuals, and required brand constraints. Heavy system sans-serif headings with readable body text. Strong outlined blocks, occasional angular accents, clear reading order. Halftone accents and offset black shadows. Palette: background #ffdc67, surface #fff9e5, text #252520, muted #59563d, accent #94332b, border #766e4c. Essential traits: Bold dark outlines; Limited primary palette; Halftone outside text. Avoid: All-caps body copy; Cluttered speech bubbles; Effects overpowering instructional content. Keep motion restrained and optional, respect reduced motion, and provide a static fallback. Adapt the appearance to the requested output format. Keep text legible, controls accessible, and content editable where supported. Resolve mandatory brand conflicts explicitly. Return the design and accurately report performed and unperformed checks.
